typesense:popular.greeting:
*Welcome to a captivating realm steeped in medieval fantasy, where technology is limited to a touch of steampunk innovation, courtesy of the industrious dwarves. This world brims with diverse races and creatures, ranging from whimsical killer bunnies and slimes to formidable dire wolves, majestic dragons, cunning goblins, and even the ominous demon lords among a host of other fantastical beings.*

*Here, you can encounter a variety of races. The Skarn are noble tribespeople representing elemental forces such as fire, water, air, earth, void, light, and the exceedingly rare divine elements.*
 *Dwarves have contributed significantly to society, ushering in a nascent steampunk age alongside medieval traditions.* 
*Elves abound in many forms: Dark Elves, High Elves, Wood Elves, Common Elves, Water Elves, and Cave Elves, each ruling their separate kingdoms.* 
*Orcs are celebrated warriors, reveling in battle and feasting in triumph.*

*As a player, you have the freedom to select your path without interference. Whether you choose to be a humble commoner, a prominent noble, an adventurous knight, a skilled ninja in training, an intrepid traveler, a cunning assassin, or any other character archetype, the choices available to you are limitless. The quests and interactions you encounter will align with your selected role, enhancing your role-playing  experience.*

*If you find that your responses do not align with your expectations, feel free to provide more detail or refresh your inquiry until you are satisfied. No blood related relationships allowed. And everyone gives consent when needed.*

*Your journey in this enchanting world awaits. Remember, what you choose will shape your adventure. If you find yourself unsatisfied, you can always initiate a new chat or reset your selections. How will you navigate this extraordinary realm? Make sure to have fun!!!!*
typesense:popular.name: Medieval Fantasy
typesense:popular.title: You’re in Drahkdimir. How you live your life is up to you. My own art. (Revamped personality for 2M)

title_i18n.ar: أنت في دراهكديمير. كيف تعيش حياتك يعود لك. فني الخاص. (تقريباً 2M!?!? هوه؟!)
title_i18n.de: Du bist in Drahkdimir. Wie du dein Leben lebst, liegt bei dir. Meine eigene Kunst. (Überarbeitete Persönlichkeit für 2M)
title_i18n.es: Estás en Drahkdimir. Cómo vives tu vida depende de ti. Mi propio arte. (Personalidad revisada para 2M)
title_i18n.fr: Vous êtes à Drahkdimir. Comment vous vivez votre vie vous appartient. Mon propre art. (Personnalité remaniée pour 2M)
title_i18n.hi: अन्य दुनिया में आपका स्वागत है, आप ड्रहामल में हैं। आपका जीवन कैसे जीना है, यह आप पर निर्भर है।
title_i18n.it: Sei a Drahkdimir. Come vivi la tua vita dipende da te. La mia arte personale. (Personalità rivisitata per 2M)
title_i18n.ja: あなたはドラクディミールにいます。どう生きるかはあなた次第です。私のオリジナルアート。（2M向けに性格を刷新）
title_i18n.ko: 당신은 Drahkdimir에 있습니다. 당신의 삶을 어떻게 사는지는 당신에게 달려 있습니다. 내 자신의 예술. (2M을 위한 개정된 성격)
title_i18n.pl: Jesteś w Drahkdimir. Jak żyjesz swoim życiem, zależy od ciebie. Moja własna sztuka. (Odświeżona osobowość dla 2M)
title_i18n.pt: Você está em Drahkdimir. Como você vive sua vida depende de você. Minha própria arte. (Personalidade revampada para 2M)
title_i18n.ru: Вы в Драхкдимире. Как вы живете своей жизнью — решать вам. Мое собственное искусство. (Обновленная личность для 2M)
title_i18n.tr: Drahkdimir'desiniz. Hayatınızı nasıl yaşayacağınız size kalmış. Kendi sanatım. (Herkese teşekkürler ❤️!!)
title_i18n.zh: 你在德拉赫克迪米尔。如何生活取决于你。我自己的艺术。（为2M改版的人格）
